scripts.title: AbirVoid Silk Road Travel Hub
scripts.features:
This is a travel only Hub. It does not autofarm yet.
I will add it in next versions if script gets enough users.

Instant teleport no longer safe, it will kick users out of game. I have still kept that option, in case it starts working again.

Tween (safe speed) method is best for long distance travel.
Tween travel at a safe speed of 100 takes less than a minute. Go max maybe 150. At 200 or more, game will probably kick you out.
But I'm sorry I cannot recommend faster, as game now has checks to see speeds also.

"Step teleport" is for quick short distance travel. Else player might fall in void.

"Humanoid Walk" only for short distance where its a straight-forward path. Or else void once again :)

Because, for Step travel and Humanoid Walk: you might go too low crossing long distances like different terrains. If you get kicked, keep travel speed to 100 studs/s or less. Don't go too fast.

High Cruise Altitude:
If you travel really long distances using "High Cruise Altitude" you might get stuck in sky for a bit. Wait for character to still try to reach destination.
If your player flies too high, you might see him getting damage. Press Stop Travel button if that happens.
And travel in smaller intervals to prevent damage. Do not stop travel when there is a blue void underneath you or else you will fall in.
Do not change settings mid travel like speed or else you might end up in wrong place.

Also, if player goes near chair, tween might stop as player will sit, so just press spacebar and tween will start again.

If a place keeps making you fall into a void, means place is too high. So increase your target height offset studs in "Travel & Settings" tab.

If it shows error cannot resolve position yet, I have not yet set that position, as I have not yet visited that city yet.

I will add it soon. For now when you go to a place which is not yet set, use the "Set Current Location for Selected" to set its position.

scripts.title: Silk Road AutoFarm V2
scripts.features: Uses a less detectable method of autofarm. Use this if whenever you try to use V1 (https://scriptblox.com/script/BEES-Silk-Road:-Trading-Simulator-Silk-Road-Auto-Farm-241237) you get kicked
scripts.script:
local character = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart

local openTrade = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameEvents.OpenTradeMenu
local purchase = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.PurchaseGoods
game:GetService("GuiService"):SetGameplayPausedNotificationEnabled(false)



function walkTo(location)
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameEvents.PathfindRequest:FireServer(
        location
    )
    task.wait(0.8)
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 250
    repeat task.wait(0.1)
    until game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.SilkRoad.MainHUDFrame.TopInfo.BannerLower.Location.Text == location
end

function sellInventory(npc)
    for i=1, 29 do
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.SellGoods:InvokeServer(npc, 1)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end


while task.wait() do
    walkTo("Antioch")

    hrp.Anchored = true

    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Antioch.AntiochTrader_Crafts:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    task.wait(0.2)


    openTrade:FireServer(
        workspace.NPCs.Antioch.AntiochTrader_Crafts
    )

    task.wait(1)
    sellInventory(workspace.NPCs.Antioch.AntiochTrader_Crafts)


    purchase:InvokeServer(
        workspace.NPCs.Antioch.AntiochTrader_Crafts,
        "Books",
        29
    )

    task.wait(0.3)
    hrp.Anchored = false

    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(4426, 59, -660))
    task.wait(0.2)

    walkTo("Tyre")

    hrp.Anchored = true
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Crafts:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    task.wait(0.2)

    openTrade:FireServer(
        workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Crafts
    )

    task.wait(1)

    sellInventory(workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Crafts)

    purchase:InvokeServer(
        workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Crafts,
        "Candles",
        29
    )
    hrp.Anchored = false

    task.wait(0.2)
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(-147, -43, -1440)
end

scripts.title: Silk Road Auto Farm
scripts.features: Buys 3 dried fish and then sells them feel free to modify what it buys/sells
scripts.script:
local hrp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local openTrade = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameEvents.OpenTradeMenu
game:GetService("GuiService"):SetGameplayPausedNotificationEnabled(false)


while task.wait(0.2) do
hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

openTrade:FireServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish
)

task.wait(0.2)

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.PurchaseGoods:InvokeServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Tyre.TyreTrader_Fish,
    "Dried Fish",
    3
)
task.wait(0.2)



hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

openTrade:FireServer(
    workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish
)

task.wait(0.2)
local sellEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameFunctions.SellGoods
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 3)
end)
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 2)
end)
task.spawn(function()
sellEvent:InvokeServer(workspace.NPCs.Damascus.DamascusTrader_Fish, 1)
end)
end
